tools.name: browse_samples
tools.description: Return curated free CC0 sample sounds from the bounded Lots of Sounds catalog. No account is required.

tools.name: search_sounds
tools.description: Search the bounded Lots of Sounds CC0 catalog by keyword, tags, category, and duration. A connected account is required. Each word in the query must match the sound name, description or a tag, so use short keywords and narrow the search with tags or max_duration. Results include timing (onset, peak

tools.name: get_sound
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for one sound in the bounded Lots of Sounds catalog by ID. A connected account is required.

tools.name: download_sound
tools.description: Return a time-limited signed download URL that expires in one hour for a sound in the bounded Lots of Sounds catalog. A connected account is required. Use this only when the user is ready to download.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the stable Lots of Sounds profile connected to this request. Use it only to identify the active plugin account.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "browse_samples" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return curated free CC0 sample sounds. No API key required. Use this to demo the catalog before a Pro key is available." → after: "Return curated free CC0 sample sounds from the bounded Lots of Sounds catalog. No account is required."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
